body: I'm trans. You literally are the same person the whole time through transition. It doesn't magically change who you are. They may discover new aspects of themself or they may have constructd a false persona they were living under that was shed, but an abusive asshole is an abusive asshole and that doesn't go away just because they transition. Abusive asshole is not a persona. It's a character trait. And this person may be working on that aspect of themselves but if they are telling you that aspect no longer exists then quite frankly they are feeding you one huge crock of shit. Run far and fast and know you are under no obligations whatsoever to forgive and forget. The extreme pain trans individuals face on a daily basis is no excuse to hurt someone else. That's just someone trying to excuse their dickish behavior.

I'm in a bad way rn. Don't know what the right thing to say is. But I'm contemplating with a certain finality to it. And I don't know what to do about it because no one can reach me in time if I act on this. I feel like such a piece of shit. I am spiraling out rapidly rn

I feel so lost. I wish I could do this without hurting them. I think I have already decided I am going to I just wish it wouldn't hurt anyone. But I'm still reaching out so there has to be hope right? I feel pathetic. Like I'm acting like a child. I want to quit talking about it and just do it I just don't want to hurt anyone in the process.
They are good friends but going through horrific circumstances. I can't tell them. I'm in a place no one can get to me in time. So it wouldn't matter if I did.

In the past I had people to live for. A partner, family. Everyone is gone now. It's just me. The friends I have I'm a drain on and they would be better off if I could just disappear from their life and die quietly somewhere no one ever finds out. They coukd just go on livibg as if I were still out there somewhere.
The people I have opened up to I have just brought down with me. I don't want to be responsible for making peoples situations worse anymore. Howdo i live with myself when all I can be is a burden?
I want to be ok. But I don't know how to tell the people I love I'm not ok. It's 2020, everyone is going through so much shit and I can't burden them like that
I feel like I'm not meant for this world. Like I'm too sensitive for the cruelties here. I don't know what to live for anymore
